question: In 2020, which scheme was announced as part of the Atmanirbhar Bharat package with the objective of supporting businesses, including MSMEs, to meet their operational liabilities and restart their businesses post COVID-19 crisis, and provided 100 per cent guarantee to Member Lending Institutions against any losses due to non-repayment of ECLGS funding?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme (ECLGS)** was announced as part of the Atmanirbhar Bharat package in 2020.
 
• The scheme aims to support businesses, including MSMEs, to meet their operational liabilities and restart their businesses post the COVID-19 crisis.
 
• Under the ECLGS, a 100 per cent guarantee is provided to Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) against any losses due to non-repayment of ECLGS funding.
 
• The scheme helps in ensuring the availability of additional funding to support businesses in overcoming the financial challenges posed by the pandemic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan** was launched by the Government of India to make the country self-reliant and resilient, especially in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The initiative includes various measures and schemes aimed at revitalizing different sectors of the economy, including agriculture, healthcare, and MSMEs.
 
• Other key schemes under Atmanirbhar Bharat include the **Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Yojana**, the **PM SVANidhi scheme**, and various reforms in the labor and agriculture sectors.
 
• The ECLGS has been extended and modified multiple times to ensure continued support to businesses and to cover a broader range of sectors affected by the pandemic.
